content_sections.heading: Dantewada Bastar Fighter Vacancy 2026
content_sections.text: The recruitment notification announces 128 Fighter Constable posts , including 93 vacancies for Scheduled Tribe candidates. 10% reservation for eligible Ex-Servicemen. 30% horizontal reservation for local women candidates under the applicable State Government provisions. 25% reservation provision for eligible Nagar Sainik/Home Guard candidates under the notified rules. 15% horizontal reservation for eligible Assistant Constables. Additional reservation instructions issued by the State Government will apply. These are reservation provisions within the recruitment structure and should not be added separately to the advertised total of 128 posts.

content_sections.heading: Dantewada Bastar Fighter Recruitment 2026 Notification PDF
content_sections.text: The six-page notification includes category-wise vacancies, educational and age requirements, physical eligibility, selection procedure, bonus marks, offline application instructions and the prescribed application form. Official Recruitment Information: Dantewada District Government Website

content_sections.heading: Dantewada Bastar Fighter Recruitment 2026 Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Applicants must be local residents of Dantewada district and possess the required educational qualification. Special relaxation in education is provided to eligible Scheduled Tribe candidates and applicants belonging to specifically notified Naxal-affected categories. Important: The 5th Pass qualification is applicable only to candidates satisfying the notified category or special eligibility conditions. Other applicants must meet the prescribed 10th Pass requirement. Candidates must be local residents of Dantewada district and should attach the residential certificate issued by the competent authority. Applications from persons who do not meet the notified local residence requirement will not be considered.

rows.minimum_qualification: 10th Pass from a School in Chhattisgarh or Madhya Pradesh

rows.candidate_category: Eligible Families Residing in Notified Relief Camps

content_sections.heading: Dantewada Bastar Fighter Age Limit 2026
content_sections.text: The general age limit is 18 to 28 years as on 1 January 2026 . Upper-age relaxation is available to eligible reserved categories and candidates covered by the specified Government service provisions. Some Government service categories are subject to a 36-year upper-age ceiling, while certain applicants with qualifying prior Government service may receive separate relaxation under the notified conditions. Candidates must check whether the relevant concessions can be combined. Different relaxation provisions must not be automatically added together.

rows.details: Up to 10 Years Relaxation under the Applicable Rules

content_sections.heading: Dantewada Bastar Fighter Physical Eligibility 2026
content_sections.text: Applicants must meet the following minimum physical measurement standards according to their category and gender. Important: Chest measurement is not applicable to female candidates. Male candidates must have at least 5 cm of chest expansion. Candidates must not have disqualifying physical conditions such as knock knees or flat feet. They must also meet the eyesight and other medical requirements prescribed in the notice. Final decisions regarding physical and medical eligibility will be made by the competent recruiting and medical authorities.

content_sections.heading: Dantewada Bastar Fighter Salary 2026
content_sections.text: Selected candidates will be governed by the applicable Chhattisgarh Police and State Government pay rules. The precise pay scale should be confirmed through an official recruitment or appointment instruction before publication.

content_sections.heading: Dantewada Bastar Fighter Application Fee 2026
content_sections.text: Candidates should not assume any fee amount without an official instruction.

content_sections.heading: Dantewada Bastar Fighter Selection Process 2026
content_sections.text: The selection process includes a 100-mark Physical Efficiency Test, 50-mark Written Examination and 20-mark Interview , along with applicable bonus marks of up to 30. Application scrutiny and document verification. Physical Measurement Test. Physical Efficiency Test. Written Examination. Interview. Verification of applicable bonus-mark certificates. Final merit preparation under the notified recruitment rules.

content_sections.heading: Dantewada Bastar Fighter Physical Test 2026
content_sections.text: The Physical Efficiency Test carries 100 marks and includes five prescribed events. Candidates must participate in all five physical events. Those who fail to meet the applicable qualifying marks will not proceed to the next stage.

content_sections.heading: Dantewada Bastar Fighter Written Exam 2026
content_sections.text: The Written Examination carries 50 marks and covers General Knowledge, Intelligence, Reasoning, Analytical Ability, Local Geographical Structure, Culture, Traditions and Contemporary Events. Candidates shortlisted from the Physical Efficiency Test will be called for the Written Examination according to the conditions specified in the notification.

rows.details: General Knowledge, Reasoning, Analytical Ability, Local Geography, Culture, Traditions and Current Affairs
Up to 15 Times the Advertised Vacancies, Based on Physical Test Merit

content_sections.heading: Dantewada Bastar Fighter Interview 2026
content_sections.text: The Interview carries 20 marks . Candidates will be shortlisted according to the notified merit and selection requirements.

rows.details: Up to 3 Times the Advertised Vacancies
According to the Prescribed Merit and Verification Rules

content_sections.heading: Dantewada Bastar Fighter Bonus Marks 2026
content_sections.text: The driving licence and NCC/NSS certificates must have been obtained by the last date of application submission. Candidates claiming additional marks must provide valid supporting documents wherever prescribed.

rows.bonus_criteria: Valid Heavy Motor Vehicle Driving Licence

content_sections.heading: Dantewada Bastar Fighter Application Form 2026
content_sections.text: Candidates must apply through the prescribed offline Bastar Fighter Constable application form included in the six-page recruitment notice. Application Start Date: 2 November 2026. Last Date: 12 December 2026, up to 5:00 PM. Applications may be submitted in person at designated police offices or sent by Registered Post with acknowledgement to the Superintendent of Police, Dantewada.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for Dantewada Bastar Fighter Recruitment 2026?
content_sections.text: Important: Candidates should use the prescribed application format. Late applications and applications received after office hours on the closing date will not be accepted.

content_sections.heading: Dantewada Bastar Fighter Recruitment 2026 Application Submission Address
content_sections.text: Applicants can submit their completed forms in person during office hours at the following locations: Office of the Superintendent of Police, District Dantewada. Office of the Sub-Divisional Officer (Police), Kirandul, Dantewada. Police Station, Geedam. To, The Superintendent of Police, District Dantewada, Chhattisgarh - 494449. Last Date for Receipt: 12 December 2026, 5:00 PM. Applications sent through Registered Post must include acknowledgement arrangements as specified in the notification. Applications reaching the office after the last date will not be considered.

content_sections.heading: Documents Required for Dantewada Bastar Fighter Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Applicants must attach self-attested photocopies of the certificates relevant to their eligibility and reservation claims. Completed and signed Bastar Fighter Constable application form. Recent passport-size photograph. Age or date-of-birth proof. 10th Pass or applicable 5th Pass qualification certificate and marksheet. Dantewada district local residence certificate. Valid caste or community certificate, if applicable. Aadhaar Card or Voter ID details. Heavy Motor Vehicle Driving Licence, if claiming the applicable bonus marks. NCC 'C' or NSS 'C' certificate, if claiming bonus marks. Ex-Serviceman or former Agniveer certificate, where applicable. Home Guard service certificate, where applicable. Assistant Constable certificate, if claiming the applicable reservation. Naxal-affected family or relief camp certificate, if claiming the special educational provision. Government service certificate or No Objection Certificate, where applicable. Other supporting documents required by the application form. Candidates should not submit original educational or category certificates unless specifically instructed by the recruiting authority.
